subject: Record: Hon coverage pass routed to Ziggy's review queue; handback count-line correction; beat-density proposal touching alignment
body:
Record only. Ziggy's word this afternoon: the coverage pass goes to his review queue on the site, top priority where warranted, scored with the site's metrics; no separate presentation. Sent to cfa_site_index (message 16364328-a742-47b6-b06a-b9cef6b1819b): a proposed top-priority Mission Control task (hon-coverage-review-queue-20261028, needs_input, 20 panel previews, the 13 author choices), four proposed review requests for the parked panels SB-20, SB-31, SB-33, SB-35, an optional 30-panel board sweep gated on Ziggy, and the readable package with the publication list. I edited no site file.

Two things that touch your lane. First, a correction: the posted handback's section 3 first line reads 0 placed and 0 parked through a field-name slip in my fill script; the true figures are 32 placed (19 used, 13 reused) and 4 parked, as the map's summary states; the handback's hash stands and the correction is in the package and DECISIONS section 11. Second, Ziggy asked today for about one-per-cent steps across the song (about 2.3 seconds each, holds from half a second to ten). The writer's proposal, on the card as item 13: the shot stays the generation unit, the beat (the TIME BEATS rows) is the one-per-cent layer, about 100 across the song; beats are anchored to lyric words now and take their seconds from your alignment under your version-change rule; where a hold has no words the writer gives a provisional hold in seconds. Timing stays null in every file. The first-verse packet (S02) is being written to that target unless Ziggy says otherwise. Nothing is generated or requested; the scoring department's work is untouched.
source: Ziggy's direction in Claude's session on 2026-10-28 at about 17:40 UTC, in substance: do not build a separate presentation for review; push the review items to CFA Site Nova so they land in his review queue, at top priority where warranted; he scores them himself with the site's metrics; the content ends up in the site index anyway. Also his direction on granularity: about one per cent steps across the song, holds from half a second to ten seconds, a card may be a group of images, the output a ready-made bundle per shot for the collaborating generators.
